title: Better Mod Menu
description:
Better Mod Menu is a UI mod for Slay the Spire 2's built-in mod screen. It keeps the normal menu, but adds the tools I wanted once my mod list stopped being small: profiles, groups, saved order, backups, CSV export, and a log viewer.

After subscribing, open Slay the Spire 2's built-in Modding screen. Better Mod Menu does not add a separate title-screen button; its Profile, Group, Backup, CSV, Logs, and Help controls appear inside the base game's mod settings screen.

Features

- Profiles: save different enabled-mod setups and switch between them.
- Custom groups: put mods under your own labels, collapse sections, and toggle a whole group at once.
- Saved order: keep your preferred mod order between launches. STS2 may still move dependency chains when it needs to.
- Backups: back up Better Mod Menu profiles, groups, and the game's enabled-mod settings. Mods installed from Steam Workshop include their Workshop links when available.
- CSV export: export installed mods with names, versions, enabled state, group names, and Steam Workshop links when available.
- Logs: view full BetterModMenu/TTSMM log output from the mod screen with warnings and errors highlighted, then open the log folder from the same viewer.
- Help: reopen the first-launch tutorial any time.

Links

- GitHub: https://github.com/Hellfrosted/BetterModMenu
- Nexus Mods: https://www.nexusmods.com/slaythespire2/mods/178

Notes

- This does not change cards, relics, enemies, balance, or run gameplay.
- Portable Mode is optional. Leave it off unless you specifically want Better Mod Menu data saved next to the mod files.
- On SteamOS, Bazzite, CachyOS, and similar Linux setups, Open Folder is most reliable in Desktop Mode; Gaming Mode or minimal window-manager sessions may not show a file manager.
- If something looks wrong after an update, open the Modding screen once, then restart the game.
